gloss: side income; extra earnings; supplementary income

definitions.gloss: side income; extra earnings; supplementary income
definitions.explanation: Income earned in addition to one's main salary or primary source of income. Includes money from side jobs, investments, freelance work, or any other secondary earning activity.

examples.english: I want to earn some side income.

notes:
Income earned outside of one's primary job. The topic of {副収入|ふくしゅうにゅう} has become increasingly popular in Japan as more people look for ways to supplement their salary through side jobs (⟦{副業|ふくぎょう}→副業：08479_fukugyou⟧).
